verses.text: Ayik ix scha'anel yich winhaj Ezequías yak'an reyal, 25 ab'il sk'inal winh. 29 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Abías sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Zacarías.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winh, wach'nhej t'a yichanh Jehová, icha wal sb'eyb'al winhaj David smam yicham winh.
Ha t'a b'ab'el uj yik b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Ezequías reyal, ix schekan winh jakchajxi stemplo Jehová, ix schekan winh wach' b'ochajxi spuertail.
Ix schekan winh awtajkot heb' winh sacerdote yet' heb' winh levita, ix molb'aj heb' winh t'a yamak'il templo chi' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ex levita, ab'ek tas ol wala': Sakb'itejek he b'a, tze sakb'itan pax stemplo Jehová, haton ko Diosal yet' heb' ko mam kicham. Ik'ekelta masanil tas manh wach'ok ayoch t'a yo'ol.
Yujto a heb' ko mam kicham, te pit yutejnak sb'a heb' t'a Jehová ko Diosal, te chuk tas k'ulejnak heb' t'a yichanh. Aktab'ilkan yuj heb', yik'nakel spensar heb' t'a skajnub'.
Smakannakkan spuertail heb', spu'annak tup sk'ak'al candil heb', maxtzak snhus incienso heb', maxtzak yak' silab' heb' to snhusjitz'a masanil t'a stemplo ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik.

Yuj chi', ix kot wal yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén tik, kuseltak ix onh ajkan yuj, te k'ixwelal pax ix onh ajkani, ix onh ochpaxkan sb'uchlab'ejok juntzanh chonhab', icha wal tz'aj eyilan tiknaik.
Yuj chi', ay heb' ko mam kicham chamnak t'a owal. Manh jantakok heb' ix ketb'eyum yet' heb' kalkuninal ik'chajnakb'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il.
Ha tiknaik ix in na'a to ol in b'o jun trato yet' Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, yik wach' syik'el yowal sk'ol t'a kib'anh.
Yuj chi', ex wetchonhab', manh eyik'ek' tiempo he b'oan stemplo Jehová, yujto ha' ex sik'aneli, yik tzeyak'an serwil, tze nhusanpaxtz'a incienso t'a yichanh, xchi winh.

Haton sb'i heb' levita ix och t'a munlajel tik: Ha t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Coat: Winhaj Mahat yuninal winhaj Amasai yet' winhaj Joel yuninal winhaj Azarías. Haxo t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Merari: Winhaj Cis yuninal winhaj Abdi yet' winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Jehalelel. Haxo t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Gersón: Winhaj Joa yuninal winhaj Zima yet' winhaj Edén yuninal winhaj Joa.
Haxo t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Elizafán: Winhaj Simri yet' winhaj Jeiel. Ha t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Asaf: Winhaj Zacarías yet' winhaj Matanías.
Haxo t'a skal yinhtilal winhaj Hemán: Ha winhaj Jehiel yet' winhaj Simei. Haxo t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jedutún: Ha winhaj Semaías yet' winhaj Uziel.

B'ab'el, ix smolb'ej heb' sk'ab' yok heb' winh, ix sakb'itan sb'a heb' winh smasanil icha yalan ley. Ixlajwi chi' ix och heb' winh t'a yol templo chi', ix sakb'itanpax templo chi' heb' winh icha yalan ley, icha ix yutej winh rey yalani, icha syal scheknab'il Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix och heb' winh sacerdote chi' t'a yol templo yik sakb'itan heb' winh. Masanil tas manh wach'ok ix ilchaj yuj heb' winh, ix laj yik'elta heb' winh, ix yik'anel heb' winh t'a yamak'il templo chi'. Haxo juntzanh heb' winh levita ix b'at julankanb'at t'a sch'olanil stitak ha' Cedrón.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u yik b'ab'el uj chi' ix syamoch heb' winh sakb'itan juntzanh yamak'il templo chi'. Haxo t'a swajxakil k'uhal ix elk'och heb' winh sakb'itan t'a sti' templo chi'. Wajxaketo k'uhal ix yak' pax heb' winh sakb'itan yol templo chi', yuj chi' 16 k'uhal ix yak' heb' winh sakb'itani, ix lajwielk'och smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och heb' winh t'a spalacio winhaj rey Ezequías chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: Toxo ix ko sakb'itej stemplo Jehová yet' altar b'aj stz'a silab', smexail ixim pan tz'em t'a yichanh Jehová yet' syamk'ab'il junjun.

Hanhejtona' ix ko sakb'itej juntzanh yamk'ab' elnakkan t'a yopisio yuj winhaj rey Acaz, ayik yochnak spitalil winh. Haxo tiknaik, toxo ix ko b'oxikanoch t'a yet'tal t'a yichanh yaltar Jehová, xchi heb' winh.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix pet k'e wan winhaj rey Ezequías chi', ix smolb'an masanil heb' yajal chonhab' chi' winh, ix b'at heb' t'a stemplo Jehová.

Ix yik'anb'at ukwanh nok' kelem wakax heb', ukwanh nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' ukwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel yet' ukwanh nok' kelemtak chiwa. Ha juntzanh nok' chi' ix yak' nok' heb' silab'il yik tz'ak'jikan lajwok smul heb' yajal yaj t'a chonhab' chi' yet' masanil heb' aj Judá chi', yik sakb'ikan pax stemplo Jehová chi'. Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh sacerdote yinhtilal winhaj Aarón to snhustz'a silab' chi' heb' t'a yib'anh altar yik Jehová.

Ix smilancham nok' wakax chi' heb' winh sacerdote chi', ix scha'an schik'il nok' heb' winh, ix stzikanem heb' winh t'a yib'anh altar chi'. Hanheja' icha chi' ix yutejpax nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' heb' winh yet' pax nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'.
Ix yik'anb'at nok' chiwa chi' heb' winh t'a yichanh winh rey yet' t'a yichanh heb' anima smasanil. Ix yak'ank'e sk'ab' heb' t'a sjolom nok' yik tz'ak'jikan lajwok smul heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix smilancham nok' heb' winh sacerdote chi', ix sekanem schik'il nok' heb' winh t'a yib'anh altar. Ha jun chi' ofrenda yuj yak'ji tup smul heb' israel chi', icha ix aj yalan winh rey chi'.

Ix ak'jipaxoch heb' winh levita yuj winhaj rey Ezequías chi' t'a stemplo Jehová yet' syamk'ab' heb' winh yik b'it: Haton k'e'en platillo, salterio, cítara, icha yajkan stzolal yuj winhaj rey David yet' winhaj Gad, haton winh ak'um razón t'a winhaj rey David chi', icha pax yaj yalankan winhaj Natán schekab' Dios. Ha juntzanh cheknab'il chi' alb'ilkan yuj Jehová yuj heb' schekab'.
Linhanoch heb' winh levita yet' yamk'ab' yik b'it ak'b'ilkan yuj winhaj rey David. Linhanpaxoch heb' winh sacerdote spu'an strompeta.

Yuj chi', ix yalan winhaj rey Ezequías chi' to snhusjitz'a silab' t'a yib'anh altar chi'. Haxo yik ix el yich snhusantz'a nok' silab' chi' heb' winh, ix el pax yich sb'itan heb' winh sb'itan chi', yik syik'ancha'anh Jehová heb' winh, ix spu'an strompeta heb' winh. Ix k'anjipax juntzanh yamk'ab' yik b'it ak'b'ilkan yuj winhaj rey David chi'.

Haxo masanil anima, nhojanem heb' ejmelal yakb'an wan sb'itan heb' winh sb'itan chi', wan spu'an pax strompeta heb' winh sacerdote. Masanto yik ix lajwi stz'ab'at silab' chi' ix och wa'an heb' winh sb'itani.
Ayik ix lajwi yak'ji silab' chi', ix em nhojan winh rey yet' masanil heb' ajun yet' chi' ejmelal.

Ix yalan winh yet' heb' winh yajal chonhab' chi' t'a heb' winh levita to syal wach' lolonel heb' winh t'a Jehová yet' juntzanh b'it sb'onakkan winhaj rey David yet' pax juntzanh yik winhaj Asaf schekab' Dios. Ix sk'anab'ajan heb' winh yet' wal stzalajk'olal, ix empax nhojan heb' winh ejmelal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a heb' anima: Yakb'an toxo ix he sakb'itej he b'a t'a yichanh Jehová icha yalan ley, kotanhek, ik'ekkot he silab' yet' eyofrenda yuj eyak'an yuj diosal t'a stemplo Jehová, xchi winh. Yuj chi' masanil heb' anima chi', ix yik'kot silab' heb' yet' yofrenda yuj yak'an yuj diosal heb'. Haxo heb' ix el wal t'a sk'ol yak'ani, ix yak' silab' heb' snhusjitz'a smasanil.
Masanil nok' nok' ix yik'kot heb' anima chi' silab'il snhusjitz'a smasanil chi', 70 nok' mam wakax, 100 nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' 200 nok' kelemtak kalnel. Ix nhusjitz'a nok' silab'il t'a Jehová.
Ha sb'isul masanil nok' ix yak' heb' silab'il chi', 600 nok' mam wakax yet' 3 mil nok' kalnel yet' nok' chiwa.

Yujto kennhej sb'isul heb' winh sacerdote, maj tzak'wanlaj heb' winh spatz'anel masanil nok' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil chi', yuj chi' ix kolwaj heb' winh yetlevitail heb' winh, yakb'an sakb'itej pax sb'a juntzanhxo heb' winh sacerdote, yujto a heb' winh levita elanhchamel ix yak'och heb' winh t'a sk'ol sakb'itan sb'a t'a yichanh juntzanh heb' winh sacerdote chi'.

Ayto nanhalxo nok' silab' chi' ix ak'chaji yet' pax xepu'al nok' silab' yik junk'olal yet' wino ix ak'chaj ofrendail yet' pax nok' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil. Ichaton chi' ix aj yelxi yich yochxi ejmelal t'a stemplo Jehová.
Ix te tzalaj winhaj Ezequías chi' yet' masanil heb' anima yuj tas ix sk'ulej Dios yet' heb', yujto elanhchamel ix yik' sb'a masanil tas ix uji chi'.
